srList.sentence: Subsequent sensitivity analyses consisted of models with a more conservative VTE outcome and other covariates to consider the impact of missing data as follows: (i) VTE definition including only DVT or PE as the outcome modeled (ii) inclusion of antiphospholipid antibody positivity (lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin antibodies, andor anti-b2-glycoprotein-1 antibodies) as an additional covariate that was not included in the main analysis because of high level of missing data (39) and (iii) inclusion of thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA) as an additional covariate of interest.
